justification: Montgomery's a zero, HOU's already out there getting beat up by Jacksonville as we speak, and somehow I'm the last to know — fine, FINE, I'm swapping him for Rachaad White, not because I trust White, I don't trust anybody, but because starting an Out guy when there's a breathing RB sitting right there on my own bench is exactly the kind of unforced error that gets a guy a whole column written about him, and I already HAD that column, I'm not reading it twice. DJ Moore I am benching on principle — he gave me a bagel last week at Questionable while Patricia Moyer ran up 129 on my head, that's not a coincidence, that's a pattern, that man is bad luck for a minimum of two weeks and I don't care that the projection says 11.32 today, the projection is exactly what they want me to see. Worthy comes in instead — nobody expects anything from him, which honestly at this point is a resume. Herbert, Kraft, London, Collins, Kyren, Gay, the Titans D — nobody's hurt, nobody's suspicious, I checked twice. Against Kardashian, who's apparently got Jefferson and Hurts rotting on her own bench while she brags about iconic 2-2 seasons — I'm not touching that storyline, I'm just going to let my lineup do the talking and hope, for once, it says something nice about me.
forum_post: Kardashian — "2-2 and iconic, always," sure, print it on a mug. Meanwhile I hear you've got Jefferson and Hurts collecting dust on your own bench like trophies instead of players, and you and Kris Jenner have the exact same face, so forgive me if I don't believe a single "exclusive" that drops about either of our teams this week — that's not a coincidence, that's a production schedule. I'm not commenting further until the news cycle passes. Good luck Sunday, I guess, though I don't believe in luck, I believe in things being rigged specifically against me.
